r4j-scrutiny2-mean-of-ratios.title: Scrutiny 2: U_r = mean(v_real/v_ideal) mean-of-ratios — defensible or distorting?
r4j-scrutiny2-mean-of-ratios.imperative: Judge: does mean-of-ratios meet invariants and is interpretable for first characterization, or distorts?
r4j-scrutiny2-mean-of-ratios.finding: RULING: DEFENSIBLE for first characterization. mean(v_real/v_ideal) per regime satisfies both L2 invariants exactly (proven by tests). Interpretation is clear: average point-by-point fraction of ceiling. Main limitation is equal-point weighting (ignores time/distance sampling density within a regime). This does not distort the sign or direction of the measurement; it is a known first-order approximation. Distortion would be a refinement concern (distance-weighted or time-weighted integral) not a correctness break. A note is sufficient. BLOCK not warranted.
